title: Backbone dynamics of azurin in solution: slow conformational change associated with deprotonation of histidine 35.
related_structures: crystal structures of P. aeruginosa azurin at pH 5.5 and pH 9.0 (Nar et al. 1991, ref 1; no PDB ids printed in the paper)
experiment: 15N T1, T2 and {1H}-15N NOE at 600 MHz (AMX 600 MHz Bruker), Lipari-Szabo model-free analysis with Modelfree 4.0 (models: S2; S2+Rex; S2+tau_e)
ligand_or_partner: Cu(I) azurin (reduced with sodium dithionite); the paper does not state explicitly whether the relaxation sample was oxidized or reduced
construct_or_mutation: P. aeruginosa azurin, 15N-labeled, wild type (128 residues)
timescale: tau_e = 1.3 ± 0.2 ns (Lys-74); Rex = 2-9.5 Hz (eight residues); Rex = 9.5 Hz (Gly-45); Rex < 1.5 Hz (majority of 25 residues fitted with Rex) (per-residue model-free fit, tau_r fixed at 4.7 ns)
other_conditions: 2 mM azurin, 90% H2O/10% D2O; tumbling: tau_r = 4.7 ((0.1) ns optimized (initial estimate 5.0 ((0.5) ns); average S2 0.86 ((0.05) in Results (abstract: 0.85 ( 0.05); average NOE 0.82 ((0.04); Gln-107 lowest S2 0.68; related structures: crystal structures at pH 5.5 and 9.0; regime (authors): Rex on the micro- to millisecond time scale; fast internal motions in loop 103-108 and turn 74-77 (pico- to nanosecond)
author_claim: Azurin is rigid on the ps-ns scale (average S2 about 0.86) except loop 103-108 and turn 74-77, which show fast internal motions; the Cu site is as rigid as the beta-sheet core; residues around His-35 show exchange broadening.
anchor: parameter is 0.86 ((0.05). The residues K74, D77, Q107,
locator: Results, Model-Free Calculations, p. 12693; Fig. 3 (per-residue S2, Rex, tau_e plotted only in figure); conditions: Experimental Procedures, Sample Preparation and NMR Spectroscopy, p. 12691
caveat_note: Average S2 is printed as 0.85 ± 0.05 in the abstract and 0.86 ± 0.05 in Results; both recorded without choosing. Per-residue S2, Rex and tau_e are in Fig. 3 and the Supporting Information tables (not available in paper.txt). The T2 data are at pH 5.5, below the His-35 pKa of 7.0. experiment: 1H 2D ROESY (50 ms mixing) and 1H-EXSY series (mixing times 20-150 ms) on unlabeled azurin, fitted with a reversible two-site exchange model (600 MHz AMX)
construct_or_mutation: P. aeruginosa azurin, non-labeled, wild type, 2 mM
residues_author: H35 (CεH1), G9, G37, G88, E91 (amide protons of the cross-peaks)
timescale: k = 45 ((6) s-1 [k = (kAB + kBA)/2; kAB = kBA = k at the pKa]; tau_ex = 11 ( 2 ms (1/(kAB + kBA)); intrinsic r = 4-8 s-1 (global fit of 10 exchange cross-peaks from five protons to a reversible two-site model)
population: equal populations of both species at the pKa (kAB = kBA = k)

author_claim: His-35 acid/base exchange between low- and high-pH forms has an average rate k = 45 ± 6 s-1 at 41 °C (tau_ex = 11 ± 2 ms); the two X-ray structures at pH 5.5 and 9.0 are present in solution and interconvert slowly.
